request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment, with monthly reporting; specific full delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms and reserve-ratio rules
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets backed by the shared BTC reserve
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards for future BTCfi projects
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
Staged treasury-supported launch liquidity with profits, yield, and returns returned quarterly to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury/BTCfi infrastructure protocol with reserve architecture, FIRE and ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, administration, legal/compliance work, go-to-market execution, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 will support protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, kept separate from operating spend and deployed in three monthly tranches of approximately USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000.

Pool 2 will fund delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution with itemized planning allocations totaling approximately USD 1.0 million.
Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve for FIRE and ICE with a reserve-ratio formula, an initial 5.0x target reserve ratio, and safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x.
FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-backed claim with upside and first-loss downside, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset.
The proposer claims Cardano lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that Alchemy would provide reusable Cardano BTCfi infrastructure rather than only a single product.
The proposer cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, Pendle, and related markets as evidence that Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is a real and growing market.

Profits, yield, and returns from treasury-supported launch liquidity are promised to be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, while principal may be returned after Alchemy reaches at least USD 60 million 30-day time-weighted average TVL and governance approves a return action.

The proposal states that unused delivery funds, ADA appreciation excess above a USD 0.35 reference-rate protection threshold, and launch-liquidity profits/yield/returns will be returned to the Treasury.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and lists mitigations including overcollateralization, audits, economic modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, disclosures, and administrator oversight.

summary: Alchemy requests 10,000,000 ada to build and launch Cardano BTCfi infrastructure around a shared BTC reserve, FIRE/ICE assets, public reporting, integrations, audits, administration, and staged treasury-supported liquidity, with several asserted treasury protections and risk mitigations.
